  • Constructor Details

    • SymbolConvention

      public SymbolConvention(EngineeringNode.Kind nodeKind, EngineeringDiagramConventionRegister.SymbolShape shape, String strokeColor, String fillColor, String sourceReference, EngineeringDiagramConventionRegister.EvidenceState evidenceState, String reviewedBy, String reviewReference, String recordedAt, String revision)
      Creates one project symbol convention.
      Parameters:
      nodeKind - canonical semantic node kind
      shape - renderer-native generic vector shape
      strokeColor - stroke colour in #RRGGBB form
      fillColor - fill colour in #RRGGBB form
      sourceReference - project convention or source-document reference
      evidenceState - proposal/review state
      reviewedBy - reviewer identity or role; required for reviewed conventions
      reviewReference - review-record reference; required for reviewed conventions
      recordedAt - explicit project timestamp, normally ISO 8601
      revision - project convention revision
